name: Maze
tagline: Maze is a continuous product discovery platform that lets teams run moderated and unmoderated user studies, prototype tests, and surveys at speed. Its AI features include automatic insight extraction from open-text responses, task path analysis, and AI interview guides. UX and product teams use it to gather feedback in hours, not weeks.
